issues.detail: The Greek 'στραφεις' is an imperative (command) meaning 'turn', but the Vietnamese 'xây lại' (rebuild/build again) is a complete mistranslation of the verb.
The Greek 'εφη' (said) refers to Jesus speaking. The Vietnamese 'phán với Si-môn' (spoke to Simon) captures the action but misses the specific structure of 'turning to the woman [and] saying'.
